findings.title: Original birth may strand its native transaction before cleanup anchor exists
findings.trace: A genuine beforeStartingTransaction callback changes captured app.key/identity metadata while native PDO is idle. Standard begin opens PDO, increments depth and creates the scoped manager record, then dispatches TransactionBeginning. The first metadata.requireCurrent rejects before frame allocation; abort(frame=null) cannot close the original new transaction.
findings.required_fix: Protect original actual birth before mutable admission can refuse: a pure authenticated post-before-start guard can reject policy/metadata/hooks/observer/manager/idle drift before physical begin; retain an original birth anchor before callback-capable admission. Never infer ownership from an active PDO or adopt a prestart foreign frame.
findings.control: Single target-operation prestart metadata withdrawal: refusal/idle original PDO/no staged DML/no leaked callbacks plus fresh retry. Keep direct prestart foreign-frame/replacement preservation positive.

findings.title: Native-only abort does not discard original scoped-manager callback records
findings.trace: 857 correctly avoids invoking the replacement current framework manager/dispatcher. Its native-only protectFailure(false) rollback branch still leaves the captured original scoped manager pending record/callbacks intact; the record can survive a retained manager and later restoration/retry.
findings.required_fix: Capture the exact standard original root record before domain callbacks. On native-only fallback, discard only that record and strict owned descendants callback-free, preserving unrelated reopened same-name root records and foreign manager records. Do not use blanket manager.rollback(name,0) as a pure discard: it invokes afterRollback callbacks. Normal genuinely owned framework rollback retains normal afterRollback semantics.
findings.control: Retained foreign same-name manager records and rollback listener untouched; retained original aborted afterCommit cannot fire later; native-only original afterRollback sentinel stays zero; ordinary owned rollback afterRollback positive fires once.

findings.title: New preparation guard has no post-call original continuity fence before domain work
findings.trace: Preparation.start invokes the supplied guard Closure after original context birth, then run immediately calls operation(context). A guard can direct-commit/reopen the captured PDO; the first domain Eloquent write can occur in that foreign frame before expected() refuses.
findings.required_fix: Re-prove the original outer frame/context immediately after preparation.start and before operation(context), without recapturing source/authority.
findings.control: Start guard normal check then commit/reopen with a native probe: refuse before feature DML, preserve the foreign transaction/probe, and permit a fresh authorized retry after its owner closes it.
